hero.title: AI agents for every stage of the employee journey.
hero.lead: {product} is an AI agent platform designed to support employees and HR from the first day to career growth, using your approved company knowledge. Each agent's availability is shown on its own page.

preview.label: Onboarding Agent answer example
preview.question: How do I request annual leave?
preview.answer: Submit annual leave through the HR Portal at least 3 working days before the planned date. The request then goes to your manager for approval.
preview.notFound: When the approved documents do not cover a question, the agent does not guess. It forwards the question to HR.

problem.title: Employee experience still runs on scattered tools
items: New hires get the same pile of documents, with no clear sense of which ones apply to their role.
HR answers the same leave, payroll and policy questions for every new cohort.
Onboarding, learning and career processes run in separate systems that do not talk to each other.
Managers have to ask HR every time they want to know where a new hire stands.

trust.title: What it does and what it does not
does: Answer from approved documents and cite the source
Say so when the information is missing and pass the question to HR
Show plans to employees only after HR approval
Make it clear to users that they are talking to an AI
doesNot: Monitor employees or read their messages and email
Score performance, stress or attrition risk
Make hiring, promotion, pay or disciplinary decisions
trust.compliance: Designed in line with KVKK and GDPR principles, with the EU AI Act requirements in mind.
trust.lead: {product} agents inform and guide. They do not make decisions, monitor employees or score them.

partners.title: Pilot partners and targets
partners.lead: We are testing the Onboarding Agent with three partner companies, each from a different angle.

targets.title: Our targets
targets.note: These are targets, not measured results. Pilot measurements are compared with a baseline agreed with HR at the start.

pricing.title: Pricing

growth.name: Growth

pricing.lead: The pilot programme is free. Plans apply once the product is generally available.

team.title: Team

contact.title: Join the pilot programme
contact.body: One department, 15-30 new or recent hires and your handbook are enough. No employee handbook yet? We can write it for you as a paid service. We set up the agent and prepare the documents together.
contact.earlyTitle: Be among the first to use this agent
contact.earlyBody: Companies on the list are first in line when the agent becomes available and help shape its scope.

login.title: Sign-in is by invitation
login.body: {product} is currently open to users invited by companies in the pilot programme. Your HR team creates your account.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: This site uses no cookies and collects no personal data from visitors. Details you send from your email client for a pilot request are used only to answer that request.

footer.about: {product} is an ecosystem of eight specialist AI agents, developed by {company} in collaboration with Antalya Bilim University.

app.subtitle: Answers come from approved company documents.
app.q2: Has the evening shuttle route changed?

features.title: One platform, shared principles
features.lead: Each agent focuses on its own job. All of them are built on the same knowledge base, the same rules and the same HR control.

grounded.title: Every answer has a source
grounded.body: Agents answer only from company documents HR has approved, and show the source with every answer. If the information is missing, they do not guess. They pass the question to HR.

plan.title: One shared employee journey
plan.body: All agents are designed to share the same journey plan, so employees can see their next step on one screen, from the first 90 days to career growth.

hr.title: HR always has the final say
hr.body: HR approves documents and templates, reviews the plans agents prepare before employees see them, and decides which agents are used.

agents.name: Onboarding Agent
agents.short: Guidance, cited answers and a task plan for the first 90 days.
agents.tagline: Runs a new hire's first 90 days with your company's own knowledge.

caps.title: Answers with sources
caps.body: Answers from approved documents and shows the source. If the information is missing, it does not guess. It passes the question to HR.

caps.title: A 30/60/90-day plan per role
caps.body: Prepares tasks, documents and dates from the role profile. The plan reaches the employee after HR approval.

caps.title: Missions and progress
caps.body: Employees see their next task and where they stand on one screen.

agents.name: HR Intelligence Agent
agents.short: Cited answers to routine HR questions.
agents.tagline: Answers leave, payroll process and policy questions from sources HR has approved.

caps.title: Self-service answers
caps.body: Employees can ask about leave, benefits and policies at any time of day.

caps.title: Repeated question insights
caps.body: HR sees which questions come up again and which documents are missing or unclear.

caps.title: Request routing
caps.body: Questions the agent cannot answer, or sensitive ones, go to the right HR person.

agents.name: Learning Agent
agents.tagline: Offers step-by-step learning paths for each role that keep the information load manageable.

caps.title: Small daily steps
caps.body: Information arrives in small, meaningful pieces each day instead of all at once.

caps.title: Role-based content
caps.body: Training material is ordered by the employee's role and experience.

caps.title: Optional badges
caps.body: Employees can track completed tasks through optional badges visible only to them.

audience: New employees and people changing roles

agents.name: Culture Agent
agents.short: Multilingual adaptation support for international employees.
agents.tagline: Helps employees from other countries settle into the company, the team and a new country.

caps.title: Country guide
caps.body: Provides information on work permits, social security and daily life from approved sources.

caps.title: Culture missions
caps.body: Introduces the company's unwritten rules through small missions instead of long lists.

caps.title: Optional buddy
caps.body: If the employee wants, they are matched with a colleague who went through a similar experience.

agents.name: Manager Agent
agents.tagline: Gives managers team-level, aggregated summaries of their team's onboarding and development.

caps.title: Weekly team summary
caps.body: Workload balance, role clarity and training completion are summarised for teams of at least 7 people.

caps.title: Evidence-based actions
caps.body: Suggests evidence-based actions based on team insights. It never shows individual data.

caps.title: Team-level workload
caps.body: Task distribution is shown at team level only. No individual monitoring, nobody is scored.

agents.name: Wellbeing Agent
agents.tagline: Brings together the wellbeing resources and support channels employees can reach on their own terms.

caps.title: Voluntary check-in
caps.body: If they choose, employees answer a short question and get pointed to relevant resources. Answers are not reported to managers or HR. It does not diagnose or infer emotions.

caps.title: Support channels
caps.body: Psychological support, flexible work and leave options are visible in one place.

caps.title: Life transitions
caps.body: Offers approved guides for periods such as returning from parental leave.

agents.name: Crisis Agent
agents.tagline: Delivers current procedures to employees during emergencies and shifts to remote work.

caps.title: Procedure guide
caps.body: Answers emergency and business continuity questions instantly from approved sources. Crisis mode never starts on its own; it needs approval from two authorised people.

caps.title: Remote start
caps.body: Provides remote first steps for new hires who cannot come to the office.

caps.title: Support routing
caps.body: Directs employees to the relevant teams and support channels.

agents.name: Career and Retention Agent
agents.tagline: An employee-led career path, development plan and internal opportunities. The company only sees aggregated reasons for staying and leaving.

caps.title: Goal setting
caps.body: Employees record their career goals and interests in a structured way.

caps.title: Growth opportunities
caps.body: Shows internal training and role opportunities that match their goals.

caps.title: Conversation prep
caps.body: Prepares a summary from the employee's own notes before a career conversation.

pilotProgram.title: How the pilot programme works
pilotProgram.lead: A free, three-month programme that starts with one department.

steps.title: Intro call
steps.body: We agree on the department, the roles and the success criteria together.

steps.title: Document preparation
steps.body: The handbook, policies and role descriptions are uploaded with HR approval.

steps.title: Three-month pilot
steps.body: 15-30 new or recent hires use the agent, HR approves plans and reviews feedback.

steps.title: Results report
steps.body: Usage, answer accuracy, feedback and progress against the agreed baseline are reported. The next step is decided together.

provide: One department and 15-30 new or recent hires
An approved handbook, policies and role descriptions. If you have no handbook, we can write it as a paid service.
An HR owner who follows the pilot
get: Support with setup and document preparation
A results report based on measurements

items.a: Hosting is agreed in the intro call based on your requirements. On-premises requests are assessed separately under the Enterprise plan.

items.q: Is employee data sent to the AI model?
items.a: Only a limited part of it. The agent is designed to use only the smallest document excerpt needed for an answer and to replace direct identifiers with pseudonyms before anything reaches the model. How each type of data is processed is shared in writing before the pilot. Company documents and employee questions are designed not to be used for model training.

items.q: Which systems does it work with?
items.a: The pilot runs in a web interface with no integration required. Slack, Microsoft Teams and HR system integrations are on the roadmap.

items.q: Can staff without a desk use it?
items.a: The web interface is designed to work in a phone browser too. How employees without a company email are invited is agreed in the intro call.
The pilot runs in Turkish. Multilingual use is on the roadmap.
It depends mostly on how ready your documents are. The timeline is agreed in the intro call. If you have no employee handbook, we can write it for you as a paid service.

We decide together based on the results report. There is no obligation to buy after the pilot. If you continue, you choose the plan that fits your headcount. Pilot data is deleted within a period agreed in writing at the end of the pilot.

items.q: Does the agent make decisions about employees?
items.a: No. Hiring, pay, promotion and disciplinary decisions always stay with people. The agent informs and guides.

security.title: Security & data
security.lead: {product} is designed to process as little employee data as possible and to make every step auditable.

items.title: Separation and encryption
items.body: Each company's documents and records are kept apart at database level. Users of one company cannot access another company's data. Data is designed to be encrypted in transit and at rest.

items.title: Role-based access
items.body: Employees see their own data. Managers and HR see only aggregated data for groups of at least 7 people; individual answers, progress and questions are never shown.

items.title: Data minimisation
items.body: Only the document excerpt needed for an answer is used. Direct identifiers are designed to be replaced with pseudonyms before anything reaches the model.

items.title: Personal and sensitive topics go to people
items.body: Individual pay, health, disciplinary and termination questions are not answered by the agent. They are routed to an authorised person.

items.title: Logging and auditability
items.body: Every answer is logged with the sources it used. HR reviews answer quality and feedback without seeing employee identities.

items.title: KVKK and GDPR
items.body: A data processing inventory and privacy notice are prepared with your company before the pilot. Pilot data is deleted within a period agreed in writing at the end of the pilot.

security.note: This page describes the product's design principles. Technical and legal details are shared in writing during the pilot conversation.
